title: द्व्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Brihatkshatra, Dhrishtaketu and the sons of Kshemadhurti fight fiercely, and Dhrishtaketu is hard pressed. Drona, enraged, turns on Satyaki.
summary.kn: ಬೃಹತ್ಕ್ಷತ್ರ, ಧೃಷ್ಟಕೇತು, ಕ್ಷೇಮಧೂರ್ತಿಯ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಉಗ್ರವಾಗಿ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಧೃಷ್ಟಕೇತು ಒತ್ತಡಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿಲುಕುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕೋಪಗೊಂಡ ದ್ರೋಣ ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: बृहत्क्षत्र, धृष्टकेतु और क्षेमधूर्ति के पुत्र उग्र युद्ध करते हैं और धृष्टकेतु पर दबाव पड़ता है। क्रुद्ध द्रोण सात्यकि की ओर मुड़ते हैं।
summary.te: బృహత్క్షత్రుడు, ధృష్టకేతువు, క్షేమధూర్తి కుమారులు భీకరంగా పోరాడతారు; ధృష్టకేతువు ఒత్తిడికి గురవుతాడు. కోపించిన ద్రోణుడు సాత్యకి వైపు తిరుగుతాడు.
summary.ta: பிருகத்க்ஷத்ரன், த்ருஷ்டகேது, க்ஷேமதூர்த்தியின் மகன்கள் கடும்போர் புரிகின்றனர்; த்ருஷ்டகேது நெருக்கடியில் சிக்குகிறான். சினமுற்ற த்ரோணர் சாத்யகியைத் திரும்பிப் பார்க்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ബൃഹത്ക്ഷത്രനും ധൃഷ്ടകേതുവും ക്ഷേമധൂർതിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാരും ഘോരമായി പൊരുതുന്നു; ധൃഷ്ടകേതു കഠിനമായി ഞെരുങ്ങുന്നു. കോപാകുലനായ ദ്രോണർ സാത്യകിയുടെ നേർക്ക് തിരിയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.82; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
बृहत्क्षत्रमथायान्तं केकयं दृढविक्रमम् ।
क्षेमधूर्तिर्महाराज विव्याधोरसि मार्गणैः ॥

meaning.en: As the Kekaya prince Brihatkshatra, firm in valor, came on, Kshemadhurti, O great king, pierced his chest with arrows.

verses.text:
बृहत्क्षत्रस्तु तं राजा नवत्या नतपर्वणाम् ।
आजघ्ने त्वरितो युद्धे द्रोणानीकबिभित्सया ॥

meaning.en: Brihatkshatra, eager to break Drona's ranks, quickly struck Kshemadhurti in the battle with ninety straight-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
क्षेमधूर्तिस्तु संक्रुद्धः केकयस्य महात्मनः ।
धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च ॥

meaning.en: Kshemadhurti, enraged, cut the great-souled Kekaya's bow with a sharp, yellow-tinted broad-headed arrow.

verses.text:
अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं शरेण नतपर्वणा ।
विव्याध हृदये तूर्णं प्रवरं सर्वधन्विनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, with a straight-jointed arrow, he swiftly struck in the heart that finest of all bowmen, whose bow was now cut.

verses.text:
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय बृहत्क्षत्रो हसन्निव ।
व्यश्वसूतध्वजं चक्रे क्षेमधूर्तिं महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: Taking up another bow, Brihatkshatra, almost laughing, left the great chariot-warrior Kshemadhurti without horses, charioteer or banner.

verses.text:
ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च ।
जहार नृपतेः कायाच्छिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम् ॥

meaning.en: Then with another sharp yellow broad-headed arrow he took from the king's body his head, bright with blazing earrings.

verses.text:
तच्छिन्नं सहसा तस्य शिरः कुञ्चितमूर्धजम् ।
सकिरीटं महीं प्राप्य बभौ ज्योतिरिवाम्बरात् ॥

meaning.en: That severed head, with its curled hair and crown, fell to the earth and shone like a star fallen from the sky.

verses.text:
तं निहत्य रणे हृष्टो बृहत्क्षत्रो महारथः ।
सहसाभ्यपतत्सैन्यं तावकं पार्थकारणात् ॥

meaning.en: Having killed him in the fight, the great chariot-warrior Brihatkshatra, delighted, suddenly attacked your army for the Pandavas' sake.

verses.text:
धृष्टकेतुमथायान्तं द्रोणहेतोः पराक्रमी ।
वीरधन्वा महेष्वासो वारयामास भारत ॥

meaning.en: As Dhrishtaketu, intent on Drona, was advancing, the mighty bowman Viradhanva, the valiant, stopped him, O Bharata.

verses.text:
तौ परस्परमासाद्य शरदंष्ट्रौ तरस्विनौ ।
शरैरनेकसाहस्रैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥

meaning.en: Meeting each other, those two fierce warriors, whose arrows were their fangs, struck at each other with many thousands of arrows.

verses.text:
तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ युयुधाते परस्परम् ।
महावने तीव्रमदौ वारणाविव यूथपौ ॥

meaning.en: Both tigers among men fought one another like two furious rutting elephant leaders in a great forest.

verses.text:
गिरिगह्वरमासाद्य शार्दूलाविव रोषितौ ।
युयुधाते महावीर्यौ परस्परजिघांसया ॥

meaning.en: Like two enraged tigers that have reached a mountain cave, those two heroes of great might fought, each wishing to kill the other.

verses.text:
तद्युद्धमासीत्तुमुलं प्रेक्षणीयं विशां पते ।
सिद्धचारणसंघानां विस्मयाद्भुतदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: That battle, O lord of men, was tumultuous and worth watching, a wonder that amazed the hosts of Siddhas and Charanas.

verses.text:
वीरधन्वा ततः क्रुद्धो धृष्टकेतोः शरासनम् ।
द्विधा चिच्छेद भल्लेन प्रहसन्निव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then Viradhanva, angered, split Dhrishtaketu's bow in two with a broad-headed arrow, almost laughing, O Bharata.

verses.text:
तदुत्सृज्य धनुश्छिन्नं चेदिराजो महारथः ।
शक्तिं जग्राह विपुलां रुक्मदण्डामयस्मयीम् ॥

meaning.en: Throwing aside that broken bow, the Chedi king, a great chariot-warrior, took up a huge iron spear with a golden shaft.

verses.text:
तां तु शक्तिं महावीर्यां दोर्भ्यामायम्य भारत ।
चिक्षेप सहसा यत्तो वीरधन्वरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Drawing that mighty spear back with both arms, O Bharata, he hurled it intently at Viradhanva's chariot.

verses.text:
स तया वीरघातिन्या शक्त्या त्वभिहतो भृशम् ।
निर्भिन्नहृदयस्तूर्णं निपपात रथान्महीम् ॥

meaning.en: Struck hard by that hero-slaying spear, his heart pierced, he quickly fell from his chariot to the ground.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्विनिहते शूरे त्रिगर्तानां महारथे ।
बलं तेऽभज्यत विभो पाण्डवेयैः समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: When that hero, the great chariot-warrior of the Trigartas, was slain, your army, O lord, was shattered on every side by the Pandavas.

verses.text:
सहदेवे ततः षष्टिं सायकान्दुर्मुखोऽक्षिपत् ।
ननाद च महानादं तर्जयन्पाण्डवं रणे ॥

meaning.en: Durmukha then shot sixty arrows at Sahadeva and roared a great roar, defying the Pandava in battle.

verses.text:
मद्रेयस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो दुर्मुखं दशभिः शरैः ।
भ्राता भ्रातरमायान्तं विव्याध प्रहसन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Madri's son, angered, laughing as it were, struck Durmukha, who was coming at him, with ten arrows, brother against brother.

verses.text:
तं रणे रभसं दृष्ट्वा सहदेवं महाबलम् ।
दुर्मुखो नवभिर्बाणैस्ताडयामास भारत ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the mighty Sahadeva furious in battle, Durmukha struck him with nine arrows, O Bharata.

verses.text:
दुर्मुखस्य तु भल्लेन छित्त्वा केतुं महाबलः ।
जघान चतुरो वाहांश्चतुर्भिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty Sahadeva cut Durmukha's banner with a broad-headed arrow and killed his four horses with four sharp arrows.

verses.text:
अथापरेण भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च ।
चिच्छेद सारथेः कायाच्छिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम् ॥

meaning.en: Then with another sharp yellow broad-headed arrow he cut off the head of Durmukha's charioteer, bright with blazing earrings.

verses.text:
क्षुरप्रेण च तीक्ष्णेन कौरव्यस्य महद्धनुः ।
सहदेवो रणे छित्त्वा तं च विव्याध पञ्चभिः ॥

meaning.en: With a keen razor-headed arrow Sahadeva cut the Kaurava's great bow in the fight and struck him with five arrows.

verses.text:
हताश्वं तु रथं त्यक्त्वा दुर्मुखो विमनास्तदा ।
आरुरोह रथं राजन्निरमित्रस्य भारत ॥

meaning.en: His horses dead, Durmukha, dejected, abandoned his chariot and climbed onto the chariot of Niramitra, O king.

verses.text:
सहदेवस्ततः क्रुद्धो निरमित्रं महाहवे ।
जघान पृतनामध्ये भल्लेन परवीरहा ॥

meaning.en: Sahadeva, enraged, killed Niramitra in that great battle with a broad-headed arrow in the midst of the army, the slayer of enemy heroes that he was.

verses.text:
स पपात रथोपस्थान्निरमित्रो जनेश्वरः ।
त्रिगर्तराजस्य सुतो व्यथयंस्तव वाहिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: The lord Niramitra, son of the Trigarta king, who had been tormenting your army, fell from the chariot's seat.

verses.text:
तं तु हत्वा महाबाहुः सहदेवो व्यरोचत ।
यथा दाशरथी रामः खरं हत्वा महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: Having killed him, the mighty-armed Sahadeva shone like Rama, son of Dasharatha, after he killed the very strong Khara.

verses.text:
हाहाकारो महानासीत्त्रिगर्तानां जनेश्वर ।
राजपुत्रं हतं दृष्ट्वा निरमित्रं महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: A great cry of lamentation went up from the Trigartas, O lord of men, when they saw the powerful prince Niramitra slain.

verses.text:
नकुलस्ते सुतं राजन्विकर्णं पृथुलोचनम् ।
मुहूर्ताज्जितवान्संख्ये तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Nakula, O king, in an instant defeated your son Vikarna of the broad eyes in battle, and it seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
सात्यकिं व्याघ्रदत्तस्तु शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ।
चक्रेऽदृश्यं साश्वसूतं सध्वजं पृतनान्तरे ॥

meaning.en: Vyaghradatta covered Satyaki with arrows of bent joints, making him, with his horses, charioteer and banner, invisible amid the army.

verses.text:
तान्निवार्य शराञ्शूरः शैनेयः कृतहस्तवत् ।
साश्वसूतध्वजं बाणैर्व्याघ्रदत्तमपातयत् ॥

meaning.en: The brave Shaineya warded off those arrows, with skilled hands, and struck Vyaghradatta down with arrows, together with his horses, charioteer and banner.

verses.text:
कुमारे निहते तस्मिन्मगधस्य सुते प्रभो ।
मागधाः सर्वतो यत्ता युयुधानमुपाद्रवन् ॥

meaning.en: When the young prince, the Magadha king's son, was killed, O lord, the Magadhas rushed upon Yuyudhana from all sides with determination.

verses.text:
विसृजन्तः शरांश्चैव तोमरांश्च सहस्रशः ।
भिण्डिपालांस्तथा प्रासान्मुद्गरान्मुसलानपि ॥

meaning.en: Releasing arrows and javelins by the thousand, and also bhindipalas, spears, maces and clubs, those heroes fought the Satvata, who was arrogant in battle.

verses.text:
अयोधयन्रणे शूराः सात्वतं युद्धदुर्मदम् ।
तांस्तु सर्वान्स बलवान्सात्यक्तिर्युद्धदुर्मदः ।
नातिकृच्छ्राद्धसन्नेव विजिग्ये पुरुषर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: But the strong Satyaki, reckless in battle, conquered all of them, almost laughing and with little difficulty, O best of men.

verses.text:
मागधान्द्रवतो दृष्ट्वा हतशेषान्समन्ततः ।
बलं तेऽभज्यत विभो युयुधानशरार्दितम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the Magadhas fleeing, the survivors scattered everywhere, your army, O lord, was broken, tormented by Yuyudhana's arrows.

verses.text:
नाशयित्वा रणे सैन्यं त्वदीयं माधवोत्तमः ।
विधुन्वानो धनुःश्रेष्ठं व्यभ्राजत महायशाः ॥

meaning.en: Having routed your army in battle, that best of the Madhavas, of great fame, shone as he twanged his excellent bow.

verses.text:
भज्यमानं बलं राजन्सात्वतेन महात्मना ।
नाभ्यवर्तत युद्धाय त्रासितं दीर्घबाहुना ॥

meaning.en: Your army, O king, being broken by the great-souled Satvata, could not turn back to fight, terrified of the long-armed hero.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणो भृशं क्रुद्धः सहसोद्वृत्य चक्षुषी ।
सात्यकिं सत्यकर्माणं स्वयमेवाभिदुद्रुवे ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona, greatly enraged, his eyes suddenly rolling up, himself rushed at Satyaki, whose deeds were true.
